title: Refined trace methods, Part II: K-theory of curve singularities, truncated polynomials and finite chain rings
summary: Nikolaus-Scholze calculus of pointed-monoid algebras and circle cells over perfectoid coefficients, birelative K and TC of normalization squares, and the resulting K-theory of the coordinate axes (Hesselholt, Speirs), planar cusps (Hesselholt-Nikolaus), truncated polynomials over perfectoid rings (Riggenbach) and finite chain rings O_K/varpi^n (Antieau-Krause-Nikolaus), with prismatic and syntomic cohomology relative to delta-rings and of filtered rings.

targets.name: cuspCount / cuspTruncationSet
targets.statement: For positive a,b and m>=0, l(a,b,m) is the number of pairs (i,j) of positive integers with ai+bj=m; S(a,b,r)={m>=1 : l(a,b,m)<=r}. For coprime a,b>=2: l(a,b,m+ab)=l(a,b,m)+1; S(a,b,r) is divisor-closed; #S(a,b,r)=(a+1)(b+1)/2-1+rab, #S/a=(r+1)b, #S/b=(r+1)a, #S/ab=r+1; the coprime part T(a,b,r)={m in S : a does not divide m, b does not divide m} is a truncation set with #T=(2r+1)(a-1)(b-1)/2 (Sylvester); conductor (a-1)(b-1).

targets.name: restriction to the coprime part
targets.statement: For a truncation set S, positive n_1..n_k and T={m in S : n_i does not divide m for all i}, T is a truncation set and for every commutative ring R the restriction W_S(R)->W_T(R) is surjective with kernel sum_i V_{n_i}W_{S/n_i}(R). In particular W_S(k)/(V_aW_{S/a}+V_bW_{S/b}) = W_{T(a,b,r)}(k) and W_{re}(R)/V_eW_r(R) = W_{T_{r,e}}(R), T_{r,e}={m<=re : e does not divide m}.

layers.title: Pointed-monoid algebras and their cyclic bar constructions

gaps.title: p-typical decomposition of big Witt vectors over Z_(p)-algebras
gaps.detail: For a prime p, a Z_(p)-algebra R and a truncation set S, the natural ring isomorphism W_S(R) = prod_{d in S prime to p} W_{s_S(d)}(R), compatible with restriction, V_n, F_n.
gaps.needs: For a prime p, a Z_(p)-algebra R and a truncation set S, the natural ring isomorphism W_S(R) = prod_{d in S prime to p} W_{s_S(d)}(R), s_S(d) = #{j >= 0 : d p^j in S}, commuting with restriction, carrying V_n and F_n for n prime to p to the reindexings up to the unit n, and carrying V_p and F_p to the p-typical V and F.
